verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state skills are written as ordinary markdown files into the repo that you own and can edit, not a proprietary format, and work across multiple harnesses (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot). This directly matches the story's plain-file, portable-across-harness claim. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that files are literally copy-pasteable markdown (only vendor docs/ADR cited) and no explicit demonstration of moving skills to a different harness in practice.
